title: Mar Zutra son of Rav Mari
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Kiddushin 65b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.65b.9) relates that Mar Zutra and Rav Ada (or Acha) Saba, the sons of Rav Mari bar Isur, divided their property and came before Rav Ashi, etc.

Hyman regards this Mar Zutra as Ravina’s colleague, younger than he but discussing matters with him, as in [Pesachim 62a:5-6](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.62a.5-6): Mar Zutra son of Rav Mari said to Ravina, “(Rav Chisda) teaches ‘since.’” In [Kiddushin 7a:13](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.7a.13) he said to him, “Was it not taught?”; in [Kiddushin 21a:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.21a.7), he said to him, “One can refute”; in [Bava Kamma 29b:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.29b.11) he said to him, “Is it comparable? This is comparable only to this”; in [Bava Metzia 55a:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.55a.3), “Rav (Hyman proposes Mar) Zutra said to him: What did you see?” etc.; in [Bava Metzia 106a:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.106a.12), he said to him, “If so”; in [Zevachim 22a:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.22a.6) he said to him, “What is it for his son? Rather, from him, to exclude”;[^4] in [Zevachim 48b:28](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.48b.28), he said to him, “And is there not tithe?”; in [Zevachim 50a:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.50a.10), he said to him, “Tithe, which is merely unconsecrated”; in [Menachot 56a:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.56a.3) he said to him, “According to Rabbi Yehudah too, what was included?” etc.; in [Chullin 108a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.108a.7) he said to him, “After all, according to whom did Rav speak? … Shall we say he disagrees with Rava?”; and in [Temurah 19a:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Temurah.19a.11) he said to him, “So too it is reasonable.” Their disputes we find in [Bava Metzia 67b:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.67b.11) and [Bava Batra 7b:4-5](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.7b.4-5). Seder HaDorot wrote that this Ravina is the early one; Hyman rejects this, arguing that he lived in the time of Rav Ashi and Ravina and was younger than he. Explicit proof is from [Chullin 108a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.108a.7), where he said to Ravina, “Shall we say he disagrees with Rava?” — and the early Ravina whom they mention lived in Rav Yosef’s days.

In [Chullin 49a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.49a.7-8): Rav Acha bar Natan (Dikdukei Soferim: Rav Acha bar Rav) said, “We attribute it”; Mar Zutra son of Rav Mari said, “We do not attribute it.” “Rav Shmuel son of Rabbi Abbahu said: Father was one of the heads of the kallah of Rafram, and he said, ‘We attribute it.’ They said this before Mar Zutra son of Rav Mari, and he did not accept it.” Hyman also infers from this that he lived in the time of Rav Ashi and Ravina, for Rav Shmuel lived in the time of the Savoraim. He is mentioned in [Nazir 22b:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.22b.1), where he said, “This is what Rami bar Chama [said].”
In [Nedarim 4a:4-6](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.4a.4-6) he disagrees with Rav Acha son of Rav Ika.[^3]

notes.text: בלי דרפרם is read כלי דרפרם, the kallah of Rafram, as disclosed before. RavAcha barNatan versus barRav, and Rav-to-Mar correction, remain supplied/attributed alternatives; note the related entry’s Ada form without automatic harmonization. Hyman’s late Ravina/Savoraim argument remains his chronology, not an authority merge.

The consulted Kiddushin 65b names Mar Zutra and Rav Ada Saba as sons of Rav Mari bar Isur. Hyman’s Acha alternative remains alongside Ada, and his Rav-to-Mar correction is not generalized. The late-Ravina, relative-age and Savoraic conclusions, including the Rafram kallah report, remain Hyman’s chronological argument rather than new genealogy or authority admission.

Kiddushin names Mar Zutra and Rav Ada Saba as sons of Rav Mari bar Isur. Chullin 108a has Mar Zutra address Ravina. Chullin 49a reads Ada bar Natan and reports Mar Zutra rejecting the report associated with Rafram. The proposed readings and chronology are Hyman’s. Heilprin explicitly identifies the Ravina in this notice as the earlier one, the identification Hyman disputes. See [Heilprin’s parallel notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1102&lang=en).

At [Zevachim 22a:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.22a.6) Mar Zutra asks about the basin’s base (לכנו), where Hyman quotes “his son” (לבנו). The second-tithe example continues from [Zevachim 48b:28](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.48b.28) into [Zevachim 49a:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.49a.1). In [Nedarim 4a:4-6](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.4a.4-6), Rav Acha son of Rav Ika discusses delaying the nazirite’s shaving, and Mar Zutra discusses delaying his offerings.
